statement: Compute intersection, union, difference and exclusive-or of planar polygon sets, including polygons with holes.
superiority: Dino 8 returns results as native curves with hole nesting resolved and keeps source layers and attributes on the output.

acceptance.corpus: Clipper2 published test polygons for each of the four operations
acceptance.tolerance: Output area equals reference area within 1e-9 relative; vertex count within +-1 of reference

statement: Choose even-odd or non-zero winding fill rules so self-overlapping and overlapping inputs are interpreted as intended.
superiority: Dino 8 previews the effect of each rule on the input and defaults to the rule matching the curve orientation.

acceptance.tolerance: Even-odd and non-zero areas equal analytic values: 5-point star non-zero area equals outer outline, even-odd leaves centre hole

statement: Inflate or deflate closed polygons by a distance with a selectable join type.
superiority: Dino 8 keeps arcs as true arcs on round joins and returns the result within a user tolerance instead of a fixed polygon approximation.

acceptance.corpus: Unit square, L-shape and a polygon with a hole offset by +-0.1
acceptance.tolerance: Square offset +0.1 round-join area equals 1+0.4+pi*0.01 within 1e-6; deflation collapses correctly

statement: Offset open polylines on both sides into a closed outline with a selectable end type.
superiority: Dino 8 offers butt, square and round end caps with true arc caps.

acceptance.corpus: Open zig-zag polyline offset by 0.5 with each end type
acceptance.tolerance: Round-cap outline area equals 2*0.5*length plus pi*0.25 within 1e-6 for straight line; no self-intersections

statement: Control miter limit, arc tolerance and numeric precision of an offset to trade speed against closeness to the native result.
superiority: Dino 8 states the actual maximum deviation after each offset and picks safe precision automatically.

acceptance.corpus: Offset of a 200-vertex outline at precision 2, 3 and 4
acceptance.tolerance: Max deviation from analytic offset under 10^(-precision) times scale; runtime decreases with lower precision

statement: Clean tiny artefacts and collinear vertices from clipped or offset outputs.
superiority: Dino 8 simplifies with a stated geometric tolerance and never changes topology.

acceptance.corpus: Output of ten consecutive offsets of a polygon
acceptance.tolerance: Area change under 1e-6 relative; vertex count reduced at least 30 percent; no new self-intersections

statement: Compute the Minkowski sum or difference of two polygons for clearance and sweep studies.
superiority: Dino 8 gives exact results for convex and non-convex pairs with preview of the swept footprint.

acceptance.corpus: Square plus circle polygon and L-shape plus rectangle
acceptance.tolerance: Sum area equals analytic value within 1e-6 (square 1x1 plus circle r=0.2: 1+0.8+pi*0.04)

statement: Accept self-intersecting, zero-length, null or invalid curves without crashing and report which inputs were skipped.
superiority: Dino 8 repairs where possible and lists skipped inputs by index with a reason.

acceptance.tolerance: No exception; 180 valid results; each of 20 skipped inputs reported by index

statement: Project curves onto a working plane and convert them to polygons at a stated tolerance before clipping, then return them in the original plane.

source.ref: Curve to polygon conversion and plane projection

superiority: Dino 8 clips arcs and splines natively where possible so nothing is faceted unless requested.

acceptance.corpus: Circles and splines clipped on tilted plane
acceptance.tolerance: Round-trip chord deviation under tolerance 0.001; plane distance zero within 1e-9

statement: Clip or offset thousands of polygons in one operation, such as an urban plan, with interactive speed.
superiority: Dino 8 runs multithreaded with spatial indexing so large plans stay interactive.

acceptance.corpus: 10k building footprints offset by 1 m and unioned
acceptance.tolerance: Result valid; time under 1 s; area equals single-thread reference within 1e-9
